motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Transition the background and border on native controls.

motion.name: navigation-indicator
motion.purpose: Reveal the underline under the current view.

motion.name: inspector-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal step settings after the selection changes.

motion.name: workflow-trace
motion.purpose: Trace the upstream path for the selected step.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove authored transitions and the inspector animation on request.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Run the pipeline with a muted brass action.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--dq-action, #c6af86); color: #201c15; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: .4rem .75rem; min-height: 2.5rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 650; transition: background-color 145ms ease-out, border-color 145ms ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #d8c3a2; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Keep editing controls on the charcoal surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary { background: var(--dq-ground, #171715); color: var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); border: 1px solid var(--dq-rule, #3c3a34); border-radius: 6px; padding: .4rem .75rem; min-height: 2.5rem; font: inherit; transition: background-color 145ms ease-out, border-color 145ms ease-out; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: var(--dq-surface, #20201d); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Step name field
components.description: Edit a step label above its input and request.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Step name<input type="text" class="ds-field-input" value="Normalize customer IDs"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .4rem; color: var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); font-size: .875rem; } .ds-field-input { background: var(--dq-surface, #20201d); color: inherit; caret-color: var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); border: 1px solid var(--dq-rule, #3c3a34); border-radius: 8px; padding: .45rem .7rem; min-height: 2.5rem; font: inherit; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: var(--dq-muted, #b4afa4); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--dq-action, #c6af86); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: An underline and stronger text show the current view.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Workspace"><button class="ds-nav-item" type="button" aria-current="page">Pipeline</button><button class="ds-nav-item" type="button">Data</button><button class="ds-nav-item" type="button">Charts</button><button class="ds-nav-item" type="button">Model</button><button class="ds-nav-item" type="button">Runs</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(.15rem, 1vw, .75rem); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; min-height: 45px; padding: .45rem .6rem; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--dq-muted, #b4afa4); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: .9rem; transition: background-color 145ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--dq-surface, #20201d); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current] { color: var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); font-weight: 650; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current]::after { position: absolute; content: ''; height: 2px; background: currentColor; inset: auto .6rem 0; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-item { transition: none; } }

components.name: Verification status
components.description: A text label and dot report the current verification state.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .36rem; padding: .18rem .5rem; border: 1px solid #514d42; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); font-size: .78rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Workflow step
components.description: Shows the step name, agent, and status. The border marks selection.
components.css: .ds-step { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 98px; text-align: left; color: var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); font: inherit; background: #262520; border: 1px solid #514e44; border-radius: 7px; padding: .72rem .75rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-step:hover { border-color: #aaa293; } .ds-step[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #c9c2b1; background: #302e27; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dq-ink, #edeae3); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-step-title { display: block; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 680; line-height: 1.23; } .ds-step-agent, .ds-step-status { display: block; font-size: .75rem; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-step-agent { color: var(--dq-muted, #b4afa4); margin: .28rem 0; } .ds-step-status { display: flex; gap: .35rem; align-items: center; margin-top: .5rem; } .ds-step-status::before { content: ''; width: .32rem; height: .32rem; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-step { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: The pipeline takes its visual structure from a technical drawing. A top navigation leaves the workflow at full width. The recipe title and actions sit above the diagram and step inspector. The same alignment and rules carry into the Data, Charts, Model, and Runs views.
